item.title: Form 5118-E: Proposal for Reclassification:
item.content:encoded:
Very very cute. Expanded an SCP I already enjoy into something even better. Some things:

+ Open
- Close

but it seems to like the name… Saying it gets its attention.

Feels awkward. I say change to:

but it seems to like the name… Say Goldie, and you're guaranteed to get its attention.

That's odd to say the least… Previous containment of humanoids have almost always been followed-up on by addressing a missing persons report.

Again, feels a bit awkward. I suggest:

That's odd to say the least… Normally containment of humanoids leads to dealing with some missing person report.

item.title: #DeerGhoulSchool:
item.content:encoded: I don't laugh out loud, but I laughed out loud. Several times. Some of the individual messages had more humour packed into them than entire tales on the site. Maybe this was just specifically targeted to my sense of humour, but I'll remember it for a long, long time.

item.title: _... ._. ___ __. . _.: Problems with your SCP.
item.content:encoded: The format is bad, like very bad, it contains not much information about your SCP, yet there were no logs, no footnotes, full special containment procedures, and a full description about your SCP. I don't want to be rude, and also sorry for saying this, but your SCP is really bad, and at this rate, it would get downrated by a lot of site members.

item.title: Live At Death:
item.content:encoded:
There's definitely a lot to unpack here but for some reason the thing that I feel like it's most important to tell you? "Eight pairs of eyes" is actually 8 people. Not 4 people. I can't explain why that bothered me the most, but it did.

I'm not sure why you used weird open circles instead of periods a couple times, out of nowhere. I hope you look through the style guides because many many things should've been capitalized that weren't (Foundation, Chaos Insurgency, probably other stuff I've lost track of already) and most of all I hope someone a bit more useful can come by and give you more detailed advice than I just did, because I can tell that you really cared and really tried here and I'm just not cut out to really help much.
